name: Claynosaurz
overview: The series follows Flea, Bex, Trix, and Milo—four lifelong dinosaur friends—as they navigate the beautiful yet chaotic world of growing up in Claynotopia, a vibrant realm shaped by clay and imagination. Framed as an adventure-comedy about friendship, creativity, and finding one's place, the series celebrates being different and accepting oneself, while discovering that sometimes it isn't the adventure itself that matters, but having the right friends to share it with.
